hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Map even numbers to positive one and odd numbers to negative one.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: A balanced subarray where evens equal odds sums to zero.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Store prefix sum frequencies in a hash map to accumulate matching zero-sum ranges in linear time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

def countEqualEvenOddSubarrays(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    counts[0] = 1
    cur = 0
    ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        cur += 1 if x % 2 == 0 else -1
        ans += counts[cur]
        counts[cur] += 1
    return ans
```

complexity.notes: Prefix transform counts balance equality pairs in single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs without prefix frequency maps scales as O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map tracks seen prefix sum occurrences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforms parity to (+1, -1) and applies prefix sum hash map.
